note: US public-domain term rules as data. Verified against Public Domain Day 2026 reporting; MUST be re-verified each 1 January, when the windows advance.

rules.authority: Works published in the US in 1930 or earlier entered the public domain on 1 January 2026 (95-year term for pre-1978 published works).
Music Modernization Act rolling schedule: recordings published in 1925 or earlier entered the public domain on 1 January 2026 (100 years).
17 U.S.C. §105 — works of the US Government are not subject to copyright protection.

caveats: A composition and its recording expire on DIFFERENT schedules; a 1930 song can still have an in-copyright 1965 recording.
Public domain in the US does not imply public domain elsewhere: most of Europe uses life of the author plus 70 years.
A public-domain film can still contain live trademarks — the test corpus in scripts/fetch_test_clips.sh exists to demonstrate exactly this.
